title: Aftermath and Silence
author: Felix Montrose
blurb: Freya Kavanagh, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. But when a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
